headline: President Bush amended an earlier order that assigns which federal agencies carry out parts of the Superfund toxic waste cleanup law.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12580, which divides up the President's powers under the Superfund law among federal agencies. The Superfund law deals with cleaning up sites polluted by hazardous substances. No summary was provided, so the specific changes this order makes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle hazardous waste cleanup
who_it_affects.how: It likely adjusts which agencies hold certain Superfund duties or powers, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 20, 2003; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
